notes: Fixes "the app never updates". The in-app update check ran once per day, silently, and a single failed check (weak network at app start) was counted as completed - blocking every retry for the next 24 hours, and release builds had no button to check again. v1.0.21 was published and served correctly the whole time; the app just refused to look. Now a failed check no longer blocks retries (the next app start re-checks automatically), and Settings has a new always-visible App update card: Check now button, current version, a clear up-to-date or failure message, and when an update exists the same download flow with progress, the Install-unknown-apps permission step and retry. If the update still does not appear, Settings > App update > Check now will show the reason instead of staying silent. Also carries all of v1.0.21: the Z.ai sign-in session fix (session check now reads the site's own Bearer token, not just cookies) and the Diagnostics section on the Z.ai tab. Same signing key - installs over v1.0.20/v1.0.21 with one tap.
